text:
maria: Quick sync — need signoff on Asterion-XL listing metadata and provenance proof before we push the marketplace tile. Targeting next Wed.
kevin: thumbs up. what specifically still outstanding?
oliver: we need: provenance hash + chain-of-custody doc, allowed redistribution flags, and the inference profile (latency/cost). sasha should confirm marketing assets.
sasha: I can do the assets, but need the final model display name and supported quantizations. Also confirm if co-marketing requires partner logo approval flow.
maria: @sasha display name = Asterion-XL (v1.2-q4). Supported quantizations: FP16, INT8-ckpt. We discussed offering a hosted-only vs downloadable SKU — legal needs to confirm redistribution permission.
legal-bot: @maria Please attach the weights provenance bundle (PGP-signed manifest) and the partner redistribution clause. We require explicit redistribution = "no-download" or "permitted-with-attribution". See checklist: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketplace-checklist
kevin: for serving metadata I'll drop the inference profile JSON here. minimal fields so we can render cost/latency estimate.
kevin: ```
{
  "seq_len": "2048",
  "throughput_rps": "120@8gpu",
  "p50_latency_ms": "45",
  "quantizations": ["fp16","int8-ckpt"]
}
```
maria: @legal-bot can you confirm whether partner-provided weights signed with OpenKey v2 satisfy export provenance for EU + UK? partner is in NL.
legal-bot: short answer: probably, but need proof of origin + export classification statement. I'll ping export-control and circle back by EOD Friday.
oliver: operational ask — Dedicated customers want a flagged "private-download" SKU for self-hosting. If legal allows, we need an extra field in metadata: "download_allowed": "true|false" and a KMS key id if true.
sasha: marketing note — co-announce window: earliest we can publish marketplace listing is 48 hours after partner signoff. Want to align with partner's press date. Partner suggested a 2-week embargo.
maria: timeline proposal: Tue signoff on provenance + redistribution clause, Wed internal ops pass, Thu partner final approval, Mon publish + co-announce. Is that tight? @kevin @oliver
kevin: tight but doable if legal responds by EOD Fri.
oliver: ops can prep the tile + sku mapping this week. I'll add a canary route to avoid noisy traffic spike. also need to confirm telemetry flags the partner opted into (usage pings). partner requested only aggregated telemetry, no raw prompts.
legal-bot: noted. Telemetry must be aggregated, and partner contract needs a clear data handling clause. I'll add that to the bundle.
maria: action items:
- @legal-bot: export + redistribution signoff by Fri EOD
- @kevin: finalize inference profile + upload to staging
- @oliver: prepare SKU variants + canary config
- @sasha: draft marketplace tile + co-announce copy
I'll update the shortlist doc and ping partner after legal OK. :thumbsup:
kevin: adding inference profile to staging now — link: https://redwood.staging/tiles/Asterion-XL
oliver: will create SKU mapping PR and tag @maria
sasha: will share draft copy by tomorrow noon
legal-bot: filing export-ticket #EX-4521 and setting reminder for Fri 17:00 UTC
maria: perfect. if anything blocks, drop it here and we can escalate. thanks everyone! :rocket:
